brief.Text: Alappaa is through the entrance behind me. A team is wise. Find the Old Man just inside and see that he is accounted for, then return. The rest of that instance is still being opened. {completequest XK1E}

progress.Text: The Old Man stands just inside Alappaa. Speak with him, then return.

turnin.Text: The Old Man is seen. Take the gift that matches your path.

after.Text: The Penumbra Xan trail ends here. The volumes you carry are Afirce's World Catalogue, one through four.
